value.answer: A few things work at almost any age: put him down when he's drowsy but not fully asleep, so he learns to drift off on his own. Keep the room dark and quiet, and use the same short routine each time, like a book, a song, then lights down. Catch the tired signs early, like rubbing eyes or getting fussy, because an overtired kid often fights sleep harder. How old is he? I can get more specific from there.
